verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly cite custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA, HIP support for AMD GPUs, and MUSA for Moore Threads GPUs, plus hybrid CPU+GPU inference for models exceeding VRAM. Community evidence corroborates real-world CUDA acceleration usage, though some report performance ceilings (e.g., 2x speedup, single-core CPU bottleneck) suggesting imperfect optimization. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically on AMD/HIP or Moore Threads MUSA backends beyond NVIDIA CUDA.
